rule: kept if the mean log score over the 11 stats falls on both the 2025 fold (fit 2023-2024) and the 2026 regular season (fit 2023-2025, to 12 April)

steps.what: every minutes constant fitted on squared error (aimed at the mean) instead of absolute error (the median)
a straight-line calibration of the projected minutes, m + c0 + c1 (m - 24), by least squares
the season-opening prior (his whole last regular season's minutes) times a factor
his first game back after missing 3-9 (10+) of the club's games: b times a (b)
a new club: b times r0 on his first game for it, r1 on his 2nd-5th
each listed player with no game on record claims d minutes in the side's scale
the side's change of minutes handed out in proportion to b^kappa (kappa 1: as now)
at a new season, the carried-in part of each rate takes share lambda (per stat) of his whole last regular season's rate in place of its closing stretch
the season-start pace bump EARLY_PACE (1.5) moved by dE, fitted with the pace exponent
each stat's mean pulled toward his own average a game: naive + beta (mu - naive), beta per stat by least squares
per stat, the regular season's mean times what happened over what was projected, by the club's games played (0-9, 10-29, 30-59, 60+)
each spread times (projected minutes / 24)^C, C per stat by maximum likelihood
each spread times E (per stat, maximum likelihood) while he has under 5 appearances this season
